Specification: This module specifies a simple concurrent ring algorithm with N processes arranged in a circle. Each process first sets its own x entry to 1, then copies the left neighbor's x value into its own y entry; the specification includes the PlusCal algorithm in comments and its translated TLA+ form with variables x, y, and pc. The model assumes N is a positive natural number, defines the behavior with Init, Next, and Spec, asserts termination as eventual completion of all processes, and proves a safety property stating that when all processes are done, at least one process has y[i] = 1. The file also develops an inductive invariant Inv, includes type correctness constraints, and contains TLAPS proofs of the main correctness theorem in two versions.
AssumeProveBlocks:
ASSUME NEW self \in 0..(N-1),
               a(self)
        PROVE  Inv'

ASSUME NEW self \in 0..(N-1),
               b(self)
        PROVE  Inv'
